_comment: Cross-platform spacing-token parity (docs/CROSS_SURFACE_UX_STRATEGY.md § 4.5). Each entry is one spacing ROLE and, per platform, the token that carries it: android / wear name `Object.Token` in Spacing.kt / WearSpacing.kt (`val Token = N.dp`, or `PaddingValues(N.dp)` for a uniform inset); ios names the `static let` in Core/Theme/GarageSpacing.swift. A platform without the role is left out; an entry must still name two. Checked by .github/scripts/spacing-parity.test.mjs on every PR (the required 'Script unit tests' check). Add an entry when a role gets a token on a second platform; a differing number or a missing token fails the check.

role: Tight grouping inside one visual unit
